text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are presenting with shortness of breath, increased abdominal girth, and a large ovarian mass. To determine the cause of these symptoms, can you tell me how long you have noticed the abdominal swelling and any associated pain?

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ovarian Cancer with Malignant Ascites and Pleural Effusion.

The patient's presentation of a large ovarian mass, rapid abdominal girth increase, and shortness of breath is highly indicative of advanced ovarian malignancy. The denial of fever, night sweats, and urinary symptoms makes pyelonephritis clinically inconsistent with her primary findings.
